decision.recommendation: STOP this variant before automatic ordinary compiler/screen.
decision.reason: The intended search fusion exists, but the hoped-for cheap cursor is a real per-level heap continuation/Maybe chain and hits retain extra prefix calls. Against only one saved logarithmic descent, these concrete costs do not justify automatically spending the next ordinary build/screen. This is an engineering prioritization judgment, not a proof of slowdown. No new candidate or rewrite is proposed. The baseline also has a visible insertion thunk and wrapper; no subtraction against zero is made.
decision.performance_claim: None; no target rerun, ordinary sample or net allocation measurement.
